## Reckons.AI task documents by email

A task dictated into a ring becomes a `proposed` AgentTask with a goal and nothing else — no declared effects, no acceptance check. It CANNOT run until a person supplies those.

`scripts/agent/tasks-export.ts --notify` renders each unauthored task as a markdown form and POSTs it here. This workflow emails it, so the form can be read on a phone.

**Reply by editing the file, not the email.** The answers go back through `scripts/agent/tasks-import.ts`, which turns them into PENDING facts for review. Accepting them in the app is what authorizes the task — nothing in this workflow grants a runner permission to do anything.

Security: add a Header Auth credential on the webhook and set N8N_CAPTURE_HEADER_NAME / N8N_CAPTURE_HEADER_VALUE in .env, matching the capture webhooks.
